pre_regulation_problem: High civil case backlog and low mediation success under PERMA 01/2008.
establishing_evidence: Court backlog & mediation failure concerns documented by MA prior to 2016.
affected_groups: Civil litigants, District Courts (PN), Religious Courts (PA).

pre_regulation_problem: Ordinary civil litigation too slow and costly for low-value commercial/consumer disputes.
establishing_evidence: Need for fast-track simple, fast, low-cost civil procedure under UU 48/2009.
affected_groups: UMKM, consumers, small creditors, District Courts.

pre_regulation_problem: Physical filing, manual summons, and in-person hearings created geographic and cost barriers.
establishing_evidence: MA judicial modernization agenda & Perpres 95/2018 SPBE mandate.

pre_regulation_problem: Gender bias, secondary victimization, and unequal access to justice for women in court.
establishing_evidence: CEDAW (UU 7/1984), Komnas Perempuan & civil society documentation.
affected_groups: Women as victims, witnesses, and litigants across all court tiers.

pre_regulation_problem: Pandemic disruptions and physical bottlenecks in criminal case transfers, warrants, and trials.
establishing_evidence: COVID-19 emergency constraints & fragmented paper-based criminal administration.
affected_groups: Defendants, prosecutors, police, judges, detention facilities.

pre_regulation_problem: Financial court-fee barriers, geographic distance from courtrooms, and lack of legal information for indigent citizens, compounded by SEMA 10/2010 preliminary hearing/putusan sela bottlenecks.
establishing_evidence: UU 48/2009, UU 16/2011 on Legal Aid, and SEMA 10/2010 procedural review.
affected_groups: Indigent litigants, rural/remote communities, women in family-law disputes, and legal aid organizations.

pre_regulation_problem: KUHAP (UU 8/1981) lacked criminal procedure for summoning, examining, indicting, and sanctioning corporations even though sectoral statutes recognized corporate criminal liability.
establishing_evidence: BPHN Rechtsvinding analysis and sectoral statutory review (UU Tipikor, UU TPPU, Fisheries, Forestry).
affected_groups: Prosecutors, criminal court judges, corporate defendants/managers, and state/public victims of corporate crime.
